name: How does Diditan Group help clients stay on budget?

mainEntity.name: How does Diditan Group help clients stay on budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clients are advised to be realistic upfront about budgets and use budget gates and checkpoints throughout the design and build phases to ensure the project stays aligned with financial expectations.
